title: Mystic Fox Spirit
description: A dark gray fox sits centered with eyes closed, its body adorned with glowing golden rings and turquoise dripping elements. Colorful orbs and paw prints cover the cracked purple ground below while golden leaf garlands and smoke float above against a dark, bokeh-filled background.
prompt: A mystical gray fox with closed eyes sits in profile, its body covered in intricate golden rings and dripping turquoise liquid. Colorful glowing orbs and paw prints scatter across cracked purple ground beneath it. Golden leaf garlands hang above with smoke rising into a dark background filled with vibrant bokeh lights in pink, purple and blue tones.
